text.string: Training only what you see in the mirror.
Train legs every week. They're some of your biggest muscles.
A new workout every week from a different video.
Pick one plan and stick with it for 6-8 weeks.
Weight too heavy, half reps, swinging your whole body.
Lower the weight. Full range, control the way down.
Guessing what you lifted last week.
Write down every set. You can't beat numbers you don't remember.
Same weights, same reps, every single week.
Add a rep or a little weight when it starts feeling easy.
Log every set in Lightweight and beat your last session.

claims_to_verify: All five are standard coaching advice; progressive overload (#1) is the best-supported principle.
'Legs are some of your biggest muscles': true (quads, glutes, hamstrings are among the largest muscles); no number given on purpose.
'Stick with it for 6-8 weeks': common coaching guidance, not from a single study.
'Ego lifting' fix ('full range, control the way down') is framed against swinging and half reps; it does not claim partial reps never work.
